subject.why: Accurately depicts the specified London townhouse, bay window, red door, and muddy footprints.

category.why: Ground band, low heroic perspective, and stylized sky meet Category 4 rules.

clean.why: Free of text, UI, watermarks, and characters.

framing.why: Neighbouring houses occupy too much frame width and eliminate required side margins.

colour.why: Bright and warm palette with clear contrast against the sky.

detail.why: Shapes remain simplified and chunky without excessive micro-detail.

style.why: Rendered with smooth volumes and satin sheen matching the references.

fix: Pull the camera back slightly and trim the adjacent buildings so they only peek in, restoring clear side margins.
